title: Budget Planning
meta: A clear plan for how much to spend on each ad channel and when to change it. From $50, delivered in 7 days or less.
h1: Ad budget planning for every channel
overview: We turn your monthly ad money into a simple plan. Using your margins, past results and goals, we work out a sensible split across channels, the daily amounts for each campaign, and the point at which you should add budget or cut it. You get a spreadsheet you can edit and a one-page summary, so you always know what each dollar is meant to do.

faq: Do I have to give you my profit margins?
Margins make the plan much better, because they set the most you can pay per sale. If you prefer not to share exact numbers, ranges work, and we mark which figures are estimates.
Does the plan work for a small budget?
Yes. A small budget needs fewer channels and more patience, and we say so honestly. We would rather recommend one channel done well than spread a little money across four.
Will you change my live campaigns?
No. This is a planning service, and we do not edit your ads. You can set the budgets yourself from the sheet, or ask for a quote on management after delivery.
What if my results are different from the plan?
Plans are built on estimates, so the sheet includes rules for what to do when results are better or worse. Real numbers always win, and you can send us updates for a revised plan.
